reference.pathophysiology: Prostaglandins sensitise nociceptors, reset hypothalamic fever set point, maintain gastric mucus and renal afferent dilation, and balance vascular thromboxane against prostacyclin. COX blockade therefore relieves pain and fever while removing gastric, renal and vascular defences in proportion to selectivity, dose and patient vulnerability. Paracetamol overdose instead injures liver through NAPQI glutathione depletion.
